title: Component catalogue (registry/catalogue.yaml)
description: Every nanoSoC-related repo on both hosts, grouped into components, each with exactly one canonical host. Owner: registry loader. A1, B1, B6, B9. Cross-file rules the loader enforces (not expressible here) are listed in docs/contracts/README.md.

external.description: Third-party repos pinned inside registered trees (e.g. picotcp). Not components: no class, never tested, not counted in A1. Listing one here stops B9 flagging its URL as unknown.

canonical.description: A1: the one canonical host. Release tags are made only here (C10).

copies.description: B6: independent repos holding the same history on another host or group. Compared every poll (SAME / AHEAD n / DIVERGED); never assumed to be mirrors.

aliases.description: B9: other names of the SAME repo (host redirects after a move or rename). A pinned URL that resolves to an alias belongs to this component.

known_rewrites.description: B3/B8: default-branch rewrites that happened before the tool watched this repo. A pinned commit listed in `lost` is REWRITTEN, not MISSING. Rewrites seen by the tool itself are recorded as rewrite_alert observations, not here.
